description:
Qualify allows Lens users get Polygon claims that proof their capabilities to get funded for their projects or act as experts in DAOs

This these claims use on-chain data categorising Lens users in different "Contributors tiers" This allows DAOs to simplify & streamline the deciton making when assessing candidates for grants, funds or a management role in a DAO.
how_its_made:
We are using Lens on-chain data to pull all the behavioural history and quantitative data.  Then we use this Lens handle data to create a claim a Polygon that categorises each attribute.
Once the Lens user has its claim, they can check our marketplace where they will find investment, grants or management role opportunities. 

If they are interested in applying the just need to select the opportunity they want to apply for and present their claim.

If the Lens user meets the criteria this will allow them to access an last mile assessment step to get founded or hired
